columns.comment: Rating event id (RTG-nnnnnn).
columns.name: rating_event_id

columns.comment: Credit obligor record rated.
columns.name: obligor_id

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Date the rating action took effect.
columns.name: effective_date

columns.comment: Initial (first rating), Affirm, Upgrade or Downgrade.
columns.name: rating_action

columns.comment: Internal grade before the action (1 best .. 10 default); null for Initial.
columns.name: grade_from

columns.comment: Internal grade after the action (1-10).
columns.name: grade_to

columns.comment: Notches moved: grade_to - grade_from (positive = downgrade / worse, negative = upgrade).
columns.name: notch_change

columns.comment: External-scale equivalent of the new grade (e.g. BB-, CCC).
columns.name: rating_equivalent_to

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage before the action (1, 2, 3); null for Initial.
columns.name: stage_from

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage after the action: 1 performing, 2 significant deterioration, 3 credit-impaired / default.
columns.name: stage_to

columns.comment: Grade move as text, e.g. 7 -> 9.
columns.name: grade_migration

columns.comment: Stage move as text, e.g. Stage 2 -> Stage 3.
columns.name: stage_migration

columns.comment: True for downgrades (grade worsened).
columns.name: is_downgrade

columns.comment: True for upgrades (grade improved).
columns.name: is_upgrade

columns.comment: True when the IFRS 9 stage changed.
columns.name: is_stage_change

columns.comment: True when the client moved into Stage 3 (default) from Stage 1 or 2.
columns.name: is_stage3_entry

columns.comment: True when the IFRS 9 stage worsened (1 -> 2, 2 -> 3, 1 -> 3).
columns.name: is_stage_deterioration

columns.comment: Grade at origination of the relationship (reference for significant deterioration).
columns.name: origination_grade

columns.comment: grade_to - origination_grade (positive = worse than at origination; >= 3 notches indicates Stage 2).
columns.name: notches_vs_origination

columns.comment: Reason recorded for the rating action, e.g. Annual review, Unlikely to pay: missed RCF payment and covenant breach.
columns.name: action_reason

columns.comment: Rating model / scorecard used.
columns.name: rating_model

columns.comment: Credit approver (employee_id) who approved the rating; join to gold.dim_employee.
columns.name: approver_id

columns.comment: Credit review (CRV-...) that produced the rating action; see fact_credit_review_workflow.workflow_item_id.
columns.name: review_id

columns.comment: Distinct EWS triggers that fired for the client in the 90 days before the action (month-end evaluations).
columns.name: n_triggers_prior_90d

columns.comment: Those triggers as a comma-separated list, e.g. COV_BREACH, DPD_30, UTIL_HIGH.
columns.name: triggers_prior_90d

comment: Internal rating actions and migrations (brief 5.4), Apr-2023 to Sep-2026: one row per rating event of a credit obligor - Initial, Affirm, Upgrade or Downgrade - with grade from -> to (1 best .. 10 default), notches (positive = worse), IFRS 9 stage from -> to, migration flags (downgrade, upgrade, stage change, Stage 3 entry), notches vs origination, reason, rating model, approver, the linked credit review and the EWS triggers that fired in the 90 days before the action. Sunda's 12-Jun-2026 downgrade 7 -> 9 into Stage 3 is here. Count downgrades with is_downgrade; rating actions are events (additive counts). Grain: one row per internal rating event.
